content: दूषण {%a.%} [दुष्-भावे-ल्युट्] .²1 Corrupting, spoiling, destroying, <ab>&c.</ab>; आपदेत्युभयलोकदूषणी <ls>Ki. 13. 64</ls>; see दुष्. .²2 Dishonouring, violating. .²3 Offending against. .²4 Opposing, counteracting. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Spoiling, corrupting, vitiating, ruining, polluting <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Violating, breaking (as an agreement). .²3 Seducing, violating, dishonouring (as a woman). .²4 Abuse, censure, blame; न चक्षमे शुभाचारः स दूषणामिवात्मनः <ls>R. 12. 46</ls>. .²5 Detraction, disparagement. .²6 Adverse argument or criticism, objection. .²7 Refutation. .²8 A fault, offence, defect, sin, crime; नोलूकोऽप्यवलोकते यदि दिवा सूर्यस्य किं दूषणम् <ls>Bh. 2. 93</ls>; हाहा धिक् परगृहवासदूषणम् <ls>U. 1. 40</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 213</ls>; <ls>H. 1. 94</ls>, <ls n="H. 1.">115</ls>, <ls n="H.">2. 139</ls>. .{@-णः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, one of the generals of Rāvaṇa, slain by Rāma; <ls>R. 12. 46</ls>.
